Start.Title: Start
Start.Subtitle: Browse, extract and convert Arma 3 PBOs, textures, sounds and models.
Start.OpenFilesText: PBOs, PAA textures, configs, sounds, models…
Start.OpenFolderText: Loads every supported file in a folder, e.g. a mod's addons folder.
Start.ConvertText: PAA ↔ PNG, WSS/OGG ↔ WAV/MP3/OGG/FLAC, configs to text.
Start.ConvertFolderText: The same for everything in a folder and its subfolders.
Start.P3dText: Debinarize models (ODOL → MLOD), extract RVMATs and model.cfg, change internal paths.
Start.PbrText: Turn _nohq / _smdi / _as / _co textures into PBR maps for Blender, Substance or a game engine.
Start.NoRecent: Nothing opened yet. Drop a PBO anywhere on PboSpy to start.
Start.Tip1: Drag PBOs or folders onto the window to open them; drag files out of the explorer to extract them.
Start.Tip2: Ctrl+click adds to the selection, Shift+click selects a range, and dragging on empty space draws a selection box.
Start.Tip3: Types in the explorer greys out file types you don't want, e.g. untick .ogg to select only the .paa files.
Start.Tip4: Ctrl+Shift+E exports the selection and converts textures, sounds and configs on the way.
Start.Tip5: Right-click a .p3d for P3D Tools or some textures for the PBR Texture Maker. Both open in their own window.
Start.ShowOnStartup: Show the start page when PboSpy opens
Start.AskMessage: Should this page open every time you start PboSpy? You can always bring it back from View > Start Page.
Pbr.Title: PBR Texture Maker
Pbr.Subtitle: Turns Arma _nohq, _smdi, _as and _co textures into PBR maps (normal, metallic, roughness, AO, base colour). PAA files work directly, no need to convert them first. Textures are paired by their RVMATs when those are there, then by matching names, then by their UV layout, so obfuscated names are fine.
Pbr.InputTip: Folder with the textures (.paa, .png…). RVMATs in it or below make the pairing exact.
Pbr.UseNamesTip: Textures that share a name (body_nohq, body_smdi…) always go together. Turn off if the names are misleading.
Pbr.FlipGreenTip: Inverts the green channel of the normal maps, for programs that expect DirectX-style normals.
Pbr.OrmTip: Also writes one image with occlusion in red, roughness in green and metallic in blue.
Pbr.EmptyTitle: Pick a folder and press Scan
Pbr.EmptyHint: Or drop a folder here. You can check and change every pairing before converting.

Names.Title: Recover scrambled names
Names.Subtitle: Obfuscated PBOs hide their file names. The originals can't be read back, but PboSpy works out what each file is from the configs, models, materials and scripts that use it and suggests a readable name. Nothing in the PBO is changed.
Names.ApplyTip: Shows the new names in the explorer and uses them when exporting, extracting or dragging files out.

Names.FoundWildcards: {0} of them contain a '*' or '?', which Windows doesn't allow in file names, so normal tools fail to extract them.
Names.FoundKept: Folders, texture suffixes (_co, _nohq, _smdi, …) and extensions were left alone, which helps to recognise the files.
Names.FoundDecoys: {0} empty decoy entries meant to confuse unpackers: {1}
Names.NotReversible: The scrambling is random, so the original names are gone for good - the suggestions describe what the files are used for.

P3dView.ExportObjTip: Save what's shown (this LOD, without proxy triangles) as GLB with PBR materials, or OBJ + MTL. _nohq becomes a normal map and _smdi a metallic/roughness map, like the PBR Texture Maker does
Export.Title: Export model
Export.FormatTip: All of these import into Roblox Studio and Blender. GLB keeps everything in one file with PBR materials; glTF, FBX and OBJ put the textures in a folder next to it.
Export.MaxTextureTip: Longest side in pixels. Roblox uses at most 1024, so larger only makes the file bigger there.
Export.Split: Split parts with more triangles than:
Export.SplitTip: Roblox takes at most 20,000 triangles per MeshPart. Pieces are cut along the part's longest side so each stays in one area.
Export.RvmatFolderTip: Searched first for the model's materials (e.g. the rvmats P3D Tools extracted), to find their _nohq and _smdi maps.
Update.AutoTip: At startup PboSpy looks for a newer release, downloads it in the background and asks before restarting. If you say later, it updates when you close it.
Update.TokenTip: Only needed if the GitHub CLI (gh) isn't installed and logged in: the releases are in a private repository. A read-only token for that repository is enough.
